meta.name: seo
meta.description: Optimize for search engine visibility and ranking. Use when asked to "improve SEO", "optimize for search", "fix meta tags", "add structured data", "sitemap optimization", or "search engine optimization".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化搜索可见度,提升自然流量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果运营网站却为搜索访客发愁
copy.tagline_en: Optimize your web pages to rank higher in searches
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a website and want more organic visitors.

howto.what: 收到请求后，Claude 会按 Lighthouse 与 Google 搜索指南做 SEO 审计：检查 robots.txt、标题、描述、图片、内部链接等，并给出技术性修改建议和代码示例。
howto.when: 当你说出“improve SEO”“fix meta tags”“add structured data”等关键词，或要求做搜索优化时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下这个页面的 SEO 问题，给出修改建议。
say.note: 会按审计清单逐项检查。

say.text: 给这个产品页加上 Product 结构化数据。
优化这张图片的 alt 文本和文件名。

howto.what_en: When asked, Claude performs SEO audits based on Lighthouse and Google Search guidelines: it checks robots.txt, title tags, meta descriptions, images, internal links, and more, then provides technical fixes and code examples.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'improve SEO', 'fix meta tags', 'add structured data', or similar search-optimization requests.

say_en.text: Audit this page for SEO issues and suggest fixes.
Add Product structured data to this product page.
Optimize this image's alt text and filename.
